# R11 item 8.7 CUSTOM_SETTINGS: baseline and impact

**Target.** L0, K0 and K1 read `CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md` when planning a new application or substantial feature, as M, M1 and L1 do. No extra normative owner. Absence or an empty file stays legitimate. Loading budgets unchanged.

**Original.** M `development-workflow:19-20` "read `SPECIFICATION.md` (and `CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md`) before planning or implementing"; M1:15-17, L1:12 equal. L0:17 "read `CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md` when tunable values are involved"; K0:14 "when it holds values"; K1:18 "when tunable values are involved". The conditional forced the agent to guess a condition the file itself answers.

**Files.** `development-workflow/SKILL.md` in L0, K0, K1. The read happens inside a workflow already invoked for planning, so no always-loaded cost.

**Related policies.** GOV-002, GOV-007, GOV-008, GOV-010, GOV-011, GOV-021. Owners stay in `CLAUDE.md` and `custom-settings`.

**Note on classification.** GOV-002 names only `SPECIFICATION.md`, so in all six the added read is a remainder. M1's unconditional line had been stored CO while K0's conditional line was CD (audit drift finding), which the corrections handle in R25.
